_what: Every word the Home screen (src/workspace/home-screen.tsx) shows. `needle_mover` is the large card for the one goal marked as the person's biggest needle mover (with none marked, the goal with the most other goals under it as Trillion's guess, `likely_*`, with Make it the one; with no goal under another, the ask-my-AI button naming the job `pick_job` in src/queued-work.json). `workstreams` is the card of open AI work grouped by the job each started from: `counts` says each overview section of parts/screen-look/show/work-state-looks.json in words and the tone a workstream's mark takes when that section is its most urgent. `add_pursuit.fields` are the boxes of the add-a-goal form; each `name` is the field record_pursuits keeps. {name} placeholders are filled from the person's own numbers. `summary` is the row of tiles under the greeting, one per part: each names the count it shows (`count`), its words under the number for exactly one (`one`) and for any other number (`many`), the screen a press opens (`opens`, src/workspace/surfaces.json) and, from `tone_from` up, the colour its number takes (`tone`). A suggestion shows only while its `show_when` holds: `fact` names one of the counts the screen knows (decisions, waiting, pursuits, messages) and `at_most` / `at_least` bound it; `opens` is the screen it opens (src/workspace/surfaces.json).
summary_free: Your AI decides with Trillion on the free plan; your decisions and goals are kept on a paid plan.

still_working._what: What every long wait on the page says as it runs (parts/ui/show/still-working, chosen in src/workspace/main.tsx): a pressed button's pending words and a screen's loading rows. The last step whose after_seconds has passed is said, with {label} the wait's own words, {seconds} how long it has run; once a busy answer was asked again by itself, `again` is said with {tries}.
